claim: jack black played guitar in school of rock.
evidence: School of Rock received an approval rating of 91% on Rotten Tomatoes based on 198 reviews with an average rating of 7.74/10. The site's critical consensus reads, "Black's exuberant, gleeful performance turns School of Rock into a hilarious, rocking good time". On Metacritic, the film has a score of 82 out of 100, based on 41 critics, indicating "universal acclaim".
